prompt: A physicist's new detector keeps failing to show tracks. He changes the design, then his goal, then the machine again, until something stable emerges.
tells: He changes the design, then his goal, then the machine again
why: Resistance and accommodation in real time: the dance of agency.
trap: It's a tight loop of resistance and response, including the goal itself.

prompt: A machinist's new CNC machine resists the cuts she wants. She accommodates by tweaking settings, the machine resists differently, and her idea of the part shifts too.
tells: the machine resists differently, and her idea of the part shifts too
trap: A constraint leads to a change; here goals, machine and person keep tuning.

prompt: Data scientists keep hitting a model that won't converge; they change features, then the loss function, then redefine what 'good enough' means for the project.
tells: then redefine what 'good enough' means for the project
why: Goals get reshaped through the resistance.
trap: It isn't a hack around a system; the goal itself is mangled.

prompt: In a lab study, a cell line keeps dying under the planned protocol. Over weeks, the protocol, the equipment and the research question are all reshaped together.
tells: the protocol, the equipment and the research question are all reshaped together
why: People, things and goals tuned together through resistance.
trap: No distinct sequence of human and material layers is coded.

prompt: An ethnographer's notes use just two words for every episode at the robotics lab: 'resistance' when the robot fails, 'accommodation' when the team adjusts.
tells: 'resistance' when the robot fails, 'accommodation' when the team adjusts
trap: A constraint is a perceived limit, not this cycle.

prompt: A 3D-printing team's parts keep warping. They adjust temperatures, the printer warps in new ways, and they end up redefining which part shapes are worth printing at all.
tells: they end up redefining which part shapes are worth printing at all
why: Resistance and accommodation reshape the goal itself.
trap: It's not one limit and one change; the goal shifts in the loop.
